title: Cyberwave Controller Reference
description: A typed reference to a controller policy: how it is looked up, and the value to look it up by. Used wherever a payload or a stored section names a controller (policy_ref, manual_controller_ref, default_runtime_routes values). `catalog_key` is the current spelling of a catalog reference; `catalog_seed_id` is its legacy spelling, accepted on read for one version and still what the backend emits until writers move to `catalog_key`.

kind.description: How `value` identifies the controller: its database uuid, its catalog key (shared across tiers), its slug.

value.description: The uuid, catalog key or slug, according to `kind`.
